name: Bristol Airport
title: Bristol Airport guide: terminals, airlines and getting there
intro: Bristol has one terminal and no train station, so getting there is the part to plan. Here's who flies from it and the best ways in.

terminals.name: The terminal
terminals.text: One terminal. A big share of flights leave between about 6am and 8am, so early mornings are the busiest time.

sections.heading: Getting to Bristol Airport
sections.text:
- **Bus:** the Airport Flyer runs from Bristol Temple Meads station and the city centre, about 30 minutes, and there are buses from Bath and Weston-super-Mare too.
- **Car:** the airport is on the A38, about 8 miles south of Bristol. Allow for traffic through the city at rush hour. There's a charge for the drop-off zone.

faqs.question: Is there a train station at Bristol Airport?
faqs.answer: No. Take the train to Bristol Temple Meads, then the Airport Flyer bus, about 30 minutes.
